title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\CircuitBreakers
name: CircuitBreakers
description: Settings controlling the volume of connections to a backend service.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.max_connections
params.description: The maximum number of connections to the backend service. If not specified, there is no limit.

params.name: data.max_pending_requests
params.description: The maximum number of pending requests allowed to the backend service. If not specified, there is no limit.

params.name: data.max_requests
params.description: The maximum number of parallel requests that allowed to the backend service. If not specified, there is no limit.

params.name: data.max_requests_per_connection
params.description: Maximum requests for a single connection to the backend service. This parameter is respected by both the HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 implementations. If not specified, there is no limit. Setting this parameter to 1 will effectively disable keep alive.

params.name: data.max_retries
params.description: The maximum number of parallel retries allowed to the backend cluster. If not specified, the default is 1.
